claim: The AWS PrivateLink FAQ says you can create up to 100 VPC endpoints per VPC; this differs from the default stated on the PrivateLink quotas page.
question: How many VPC endpoints can I create in a single VPC, according to the FAQ?

values.display: up to 100 VPC endpoints per VPC
values.spoken: up to one hundred VPC endpoints per VPC

qualifiers.condition: the FAQ answer does not say whether the maximum can be raised; the quotas page vpc-endpoints-quota-interface-gwlb-per-vpc gives a lower default that is adjustable

evidence.quote: You can create up to 100 VPC endpoints per VPC.

note: CONFLICT WITH QUOTAS PAGE: the FAQ says up to 100 endpoints per VPC; vpc-limits-endpoints lists a default of 50 interface and Gateway Load Balancer endpoints per VPC (adjustable). Writers use the quotas page for the number and may mention that the FAQ differs.
